newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $2-$3, top $69.50 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $2-$3, top $69.50 -USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.50-$3.00 per cwt higher, compared to last test on Thursday, USDA said.
Trade was active and demand strong. Seller interest was moderate early, later strong. Offerings fairly light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 68.00-69.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1200 lbs few 68.00.
